title: History & Biography
blurb: The record of what happened, and the lives that shaped it.

planned.title: The Histories
planned.author: Herodotus
planned.note: The first work of history — Herodotus on the war between Greece and Persia, and everything he learned along the way.

planned.title: History of the Peloponnesian War
planned.author: Thucydides
planned.note: Thucydides on the war that broke Athens — history written cold, as a possession for all time.

planned.title: Lives
planned.author: Plutarch
planned.note: Plutarch's paired lives of Greeks and Romans that taught Europe what greatness looks like.

planned.title: The Annals
planned.author: Tacitus
planned.note: Tacitus on the early Roman emperors — power, fear, and corruption, in the most unsparing prose of antiquity.

planned.title: The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire
planned.author: Edward Gibbon
planned.note: Gibbon's vast, ironic chronicle of how the greatest empire of antiquity came undone.

planned.title: Democracy in America
planned.author: Alexis de Tocqueville
planned.note: Tocqueville's clear-eyed report on the young United States — democracy's promise and its perils.

planned.title: Records of the Grand Historian
planned.author: Sima Qian
planned.note: The founding work of Chinese history, whose author chose disgrace over death to finish it.

planned.title: The Travels of Ibn Battuta
planned.author: Ibn Battuta
planned.note: Thirty years and the whole medieval world on foot — the greatest travel book before modern times.

planned.title: The Muqaddimah
planned.author: Ibn Khaldun
planned.note: The first science of history and society — why civilizations cohere, harden, and fall; sociology founded centuries early.

planned.title: The Kojiki
planned.author: Ō no Yasumaro
planned.note: Japan's oldest book — the myths of the gods and the origins of the islands and their emperors.

planned.title: Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass
planned.author: Frederick Douglass
planned.note: The escaped slave who wrote his own freedom — the most powerful American memoir of the century.

planned.title: Seven Pillars of Wisdom
planned.author: T. E. Lawrence
planned.note: Lawrence's first-hand epic of the Arab Revolt — guerrilla war across the desert, and the making and unmaking of a legend.

planned.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
planned.author: Benjamin Franklin
planned.note: The model American life, told by the man who invented himself — printer, scientist, statesman.

planned.title: Journal
planned.author: John Woolman
planned.note: The inner life of a Quaker conscience — an early, searching American voice against slavery.

planned.title: The Lives of Donne and Herbert
planned.author: Izaak Walton
planned.note: Izaak Walton's tender biographies of two English poet-priests.

planned.title: Two Years Before the Mast
planned.author: Richard Henry Dana
planned.note: A Harvard man's plain account of life as a common sailor — the sea without romance.

planned.title: The Voyage of the Beagle
planned.author: Charles Darwin
planned.note: The young naturalist's travel journal — the voyage that planted evolution.

planned.title: The Autobiography of Benvenuto Cellini
planned.author: Benvenuto Cellini
planned.note: The swaggering memoir of a Renaissance goldsmith — art, brawls, and bravado.

planned.title: Voyages and Travels
planned.note: Great first-hand accounts of exploration, ancient and modern.

planned.title: Chronicle and Romance
planned.author: Froissart, Malory, Holinshed
planned.note: Froissart, Malory, and Holinshed — the chronicles and legends behind medieval England.

planned.title: American Historical Documents
planned.note: The charters and speeches that made a nation, 1000–1904.
